headline: Place & Directions · Foundation
threshold: Understand, give, clarify, and carry out practical placement and route instructions.

lessons.title: Under and on
lessons.objective: Under and on: understand and carry out the instruction, identify the reference point, then describe or confirm the destination.

words.es: Pon el martillo debajo de la mesa.
words.en: Put the hammer under the table.

words.es: El martillo está encima de la mesa.
words.en: The hammer is on top of the table.

words.es: Confirma el destino antes de moverlo.
words.en: Confirm the destination before moving it.

lessons.speaking: Role-play under and on. Start with: Pon el martillo debajo de la mesa. Ask your partner to clarify one reference point, complete the task in words, and confirm the final position.
lessons.partnerRole: Spanish-speaking partner giving placement and route instructions
lessons.openingLine: Pon el martillo debajo de la mesa.
